scope: YLM26 Tahsili Mathematics source-vs-live baseline audit

source.file: كتاب تأسيس يلو للرياضيات 26 - النسخة المعدلة.pdf
source.intendedScope: Questions explicitly marked تجميعات only; examples/explanations are not bank questions.

criticalFindings: The live import is incomplete: 156 records vs 326 source compilation questions.
126/156 records use generic placeholder question text and A/B/C/D as AI option texts, so they are not content-locked.

Question identity numbering is inconsistent with the source lesson numbering. Example: source page 8 contains compilation questions 5–8, while live records are coded P008-Q01/P008-Q02. On page 9 the rich slope question is source compilation #1 but stored as P009-Q02.
At least 60 records have a main-skill assignment inconsistent with the source lesson/taxonomy page range; subskill correctness is therefore also not reliable.
No YLM26 record is approved and no quiz/mock exam currently references any of the 156 records, so the corrupted draft set is not exposed to students.
policy: Do not approve or patch generic records by guess. Re-extract all compilation questions canonically from the source, preserve page + true printed compilation number, then perform answer/solution/subskill content lock.
